title: aeranthes lansbergii
intro: Aeranthes lansbergii, commonly known as the Butterfly Orchid, is a species of orchid found in the tropical regions of Madagascar. This plant is known for its unique flowers, which attract pollinators such as butterflies and bees. Aeranthes lansbergii has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of Aeranthes lansbergii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties.
